title: AgentIdeaBench: Benchmarking Scientific Ideation in the Agent Era
abstract: arXiv:2609.07611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific ideation is the capacity to formulate novel and testable hypotheses from scientific evidence, and autonomous AI scientists depend on it. Existing evaluations largely assess it by asking models to generate ideas from a static, curated set of reference papers. That passive setup departs from the retrieval-and-reasoning workflow of modern AI scientists, and it becomes less discriminative as models improve. We introduce AgentIdeaBench, a multidisciplinary benchmark that evaluates scientific ideation under two matched settings, static observation and active exploration. We report matched Static-Active evaluations for 33 LLMs across 40 densely scored subfields spanning five disciplines, using a multidimensional, literature-verified scoring framework whose critics assess originality against retrieved prior art. Active exploration reveals considerably more capability headroom, and that headroom is unevenly distributed across models. P

translated_title: AgentIdeaBench：智能体时代的科学构想能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 科学构想是指从科学证据中提出新颖且可检验假设的能力，自主AI科学家正依赖这一能力。现有评估主要通过要求模型从静态、精选的参考论文集中生成想法来进行，这种被动设置偏离了现代AI科学家的检索与推理工作流程，且随着模型的不断进步，其区分能力日益下降。我们提出了AgentIdeaBench，这是一个多学科基准，在两种相互匹配的设置下评估科学构想能力：静态观察与主动探索。我们报告了对33个大语言模型在横跨五个学科的40个密集评分子领域中的匹配的静态-主动评估结果，并采用了一个多维度、经文献验证的评分框架，其中的评估者会依据检索到的现有研究来评判原创性。结果显示，主动探索揭示了远为可观的能力提升空间，且该空间在各模型间分布并不均衡。
tldr: AgentIdeaBench是一个多学科基准，首次在静态观察与主动探索两种匹配设置下评估AI科学构想能力，发现主动探索能揭示显著更大且在各模型间分布不均的能力提升空间。
en_tdlr: AgentIdeaBench is a multidisciplinary benchmark evaluating scientific ideation under matched static and active exploration settings, revealing that active exploration exposes considerably more capability headroom, which is unevenly distributed across 33 LLMs.
